title: Pure Dark Blade
summary: Dark Blade is a classic Level 4 DARK Warrior Normal Monster and Union/Fusion strategy centered around equipping Pitch-Dark Dragon and Kiryu to Dark Blade to grant piercing damage and card protection, or fusing them into Dark Blade the Dragon Knight to banish cards from the opponent's GY.

allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Dark Blade directly from the Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Rescue Rabbit: Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Dark Blade directly from the Deck.
allow.Fusion Deployment: Reveals Dark Blade the Dragon Knight in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Dark Blade, Pitch-Dark Dragon, or Kiryu from the Deck.
allow.Polymerization: Fuses Dark Blade with Pitch-Dark Dragon to summon Dark Blade the Dragon Knight.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches Dark Blade or Dark Blade the Captain of the Evil World from the Deck.
allow.Roll Out!: Normal Trap that equips Pitch-Dark Dragon or Kiryu from the GY directly to Dark Blade.
allow.First of the Dragons: Fusion boss summoned using 2 Normal Monsters (Dark Blade) that is unaffected by other monsters' effects.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 Warrior made with two Dark Blades that boosts all Warriors by 500 ATK and revives a Warrior upon destruction.

main: Dark Blade
Signature Level 4 DARK Warrior Normal Monster with 1800 ATK that serves as the host for Pitch-Dark Dragon and Kiryu and Fusion Material for Dragon Knight.
Dark Blade the Captain of the Evil World
Effect retrain of Dark Blade that banishes 1 DARK monster from GY to equip a Level 4 or lower LIGHT monster from opponent's field, and tributes an Equip to destroy a card.
Pitch-Dark Dragon
DARK Dragon Union monster that equips to Dark Blade to boost its ATK/DEF by 400 and grant piercing battle damage.
Kiryu
DARK Dragon Union monster that tributes a DARK monster to summon itself and equips to Dark Blade to boost its ATK/DEF by 900 (to 2700 ATK).
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to summon 2 Dark Blade from the Deck for Fusion, Xyz, or Link plays.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Dark Blade from the Deck without using your Normal Summon.
Fusion Deployment
Reveals Dark Blade the Dragon Knight to summon Dark Blade or Pitch-Dark Dragon directly from the Deck.
Polymerization
Fuses Dark Blade and Pitch-Dark Dragon (or two Normal Dark Blades into First of the Dragons).
Reinforcement of the Army
Searches Dark Blade or Dark Blade the Captain of the Evil World.
Roll Out!
Equips Pitch-Dark Dragon or Kiryu from your GY to Dark Blade during either player's turn.
extra: Signature Level 6 DARK Warrior Fusion boss (Dark Blade + Pitch-Dark Dragon) that banishes up to 3 Monster Cards from the opponent's GY every time it inflicts battle damage.
Level 9 Dragon Fusion made with 2 Dark Blades that cannot be destroyed by battle except with a Normal Monster and is unaffected by monster effects.
Link-2 Warrior that extends plays using two Dark Blades.
